conditional: failure.log only for infrastructure or unexpected terminal failure

model_input_retention.policy: Store only dynamic model-visible information. Do not repeat prompt templates or upstream static fault metadata.
model_input_retention.round0: Compact Golden behavior plus training_observation when present.
model_input_retention.golden_repair: Previous verdict plus the fact that valid Golden behavior violated the previous property. No exact Golden counterexample.
model_input_retention.localized_fault: Selected alias, evidence types, and expanded Golden behavior.
model_input_retention.fault_counterexample: Exact counterexample information actually exposed to the model.

upstream_metadata_policy: Do not duplicate design/module/site/source/polarity/source_kind/receiver metadata in Stage6 durable results. Resolve them by fault_id from frozen Stage4/Stage5 sources.
future_campaign_ordering_policy: Freeze one deterministic ordered eligible fault list once. --next N always consumes the next N unfinished faults from that frozen order.
